thread:
sales-jess: Hey all — running a POC with Acme Health. Their dev reports intermittent 502s and ECONNRESET when our SDK talks to the hosted inference. Happens behind their bastion/proxy.

customer-dave: Paste from their edge logs:

```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z ERROR proxy: upstream returned 502 Bad Gateway
requests.exceptions.ProxyError: ('Cannot connect to proxy.', ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer'))
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
> GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1\n> Host: api.redwood.ai\n< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n< Via: 1.1 bastion.company.net\n```

eng-samir: Got it. Can you confirm which client (Python/TS), SDK version, and whether they're setting HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY or a local SOCKS proxy? Also any retries/timeouts configured? :eyes:

customer-dave: They're using the Python SDK from a company image. Minimal snippet they gave:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = c.generate("summarize...")
```

alex-eng: Two likely culprits: 1) their bastion/proxy is killing long-lived connections / HTTP keep-alive -> ECONNRESET; 2) intermediate proxy returning 502 on streaming or large payloads. Quick mitigation: force shorter timeouts and enable exponential retries in the client, or route traffic through a proxy that supports passthrough.

Here are suggested quick changes (Python):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RetryConfig
c = RedwoodClient(
  api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'),
  timeout=60,                # increase request timeout
  retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=5, backoff_factor=0.5),
  proxies={"http": "http://bastion.company.net:3128", "https": "http://bastion.company.net:3128"}
)
resp = c.generate(...)
```

And TypeScript suggestion if they test from a node sidecar:

```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, timeoutMs: 60000, maxRetries: 5 })
// set env HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY in the process or container
```

maria-ps: FYI, if their proxy terminates TLS early or rewrites responses, retries can make things worse. Recommend they add no_proxy for internal health checks and for any direct calls to our internal IPs to bypass the bastion. Also ask them to enable TCP keepalive or lower idle timeouts on the bastion.

eng-samir: For debugging ask them to capture a short tcpdump or curl with --trace to show the TLS handshake and where it drops. If we confirm the proxy is dropping mid-stream we can also temporarily bump their quota and enable shorter connection windows on our side (e.g., disable streaming for that POC route) so requests complete more quickly.

customer-dave: They're going to try setting HTTPS_PROXY and no_proxy and add the retry config. Also will run a tcpdump and send. Thanks. :thumbsup:

zach-oncall-bot: deploy-notify: Canary rollout to hosted-inference v1.34 completed at 2026-03-15T14:05:00Z

sales-jess: Awesome. If this is a time-sensitive demo, we can also temporarily raise their per-minute rate limit and switch them to a non-streaming fallback until the bastion changes are in. Ping me if tcpdump confirms proxy resets.

eng-samir: +1. If tcpdump shows RST from bastion, we'll ask infra to provide a short-lived bypass for the demo.
